+	tests := []struct {
+		constraint string
+		version    string
+		check      bool
+	}{
+		{"1.5.0 - 4.5", "3.7.0", true},
+		{"1.5.0 - 4.5", "1.5.0", true},
+		{"1.5.0 - 4.5", "4.5.9", true},
+		{"1.5.0 - 4.5", "4.6.0", false},
+		{"1.5.0 - 4.5", "5.0.0", false},
+		{"1.5.0 - 4.5", "1.4.9", false},
+		{"<=4.5", "3.7.0", true},
+		{"<=4.5", "4.6.0", false},
+		{"<=4.x", "3.7.0", true},
+		{"<=4.x", "5.0.0", false},
+		{"<=4.5.x", "3.9.9", true},
+		{"<=4.5.x", "4.6.0", false},
+	}
+

+		c, err := NewConstraint(tc.constraint)
+		if err != nil {
+			t.Errorf("err: %s", err)
+			continue
+		}
+

+		if err != nil {
+			t.Errorf("err: %s", err)
+			continue
+		}
+
+		if a := c.Check(v); a != tc.check {
+			t.Errorf("Constraint '%s' with '%s': got %v want %v", tc.constraint, tc.version, a, tc.check)
+		}
+	}

+import unittest
+

+

+class SetItemGrowTest(unittest.TestCase):
+    def check_no_eviction(self, cls):
+        cache = cls(maxsize=10, getsizeof=lambda v: v)
+        cache["a"] = 3
+        cache["b"] = 3
+        cache["b"] = 7  # a(3) + b(7) == maxsize, fits
+        self.assertEqual({"a": 3, "b": 7}, dict(cache))
+        self.assertEqual(10, cache.currsize)
+
+    def test_lru_grow_fits(self):
+        self.check_no_eviction(cachetools.LRUCache)
+
+    def test_fifo_grow_fits(self):
+        self.check_no_eviction(cachetools.FIFOCache)
+
+    def test_cache_grow_fits(self):
+        self.check_no_eviction(cachetools.Cache)
+
+    def test_rr_grow_fits(self):
+        self.check_no_eviction(cachetools.RRCache)
+
+    def test_lfu_grow_fits(self):
+        self.check_no_eviction(cachetools.LFUCache)
+
+    def test_grow_overflows_evicts_others(self):
+        cache = cachetools.FIFOCache(maxsize=10, getsizeof=lambda v: v)
+        cache["a"] = 3
+        cache["b"] = 3
+        cache["b"] = 8  # 3 + 8 > 10, must evict "a"
+        self.assertEqual({"b": 8}, dict(cache))
+        self.assertEqual(8, cache.currsize)
+
+    def test_grow_matches_delete_then_insert(self):
+        ref = cachetools.LRUCache(maxsize=10, getsizeof=lambda v: v)
+        ref["a"] = 3
+        ref["b"] = 3
+        del ref["b"]
+        ref["b"] = 7
+
+        cache = cachetools.LRUCache(maxsize=10, getsizeof=lambda v: v)
+        cache["a"] = 3
+        cache["b"] = 3
+        cache["b"] = 7
+        self.assertEqual(dict(ref), dict(cache))
+        self.assertEqual(ref.currsize, cache.currsize)
